hero_title: Learn, ask and get help, all in one safe app
hero_text: GirlCare72 gives girls and young women in Imvepi short lessons about their body, health and safety, answers to their questions, and a free call back when they need help.

ways.title: Flash or call
ways.text: Flash or call the free number from any phone. A trained responder calls you back at a safe time.

ways.title: Text
ways.text: Send HELP for a call back, LEARN for a weekly lesson, or ASK and your question.

ways.title: Use the app
ways.text: Lessons, quizzes and Ask GirlCare on a smartphone. Get help in one tap.

features_title: What the app gives every girl

features.title: Short lessons
features.text: Eight lessons for ages 10 to 14 and 15 to 24, with a story, a quiz and audio.

features.title: Ask GirlCare
features.text: Ask anything about your body, health or safety. Answers come only from approved lessons.

features.title: Get help
features.text: One tap for a call back. If you need care, we send a free ride to the health centre.

features.title: Private by design
features.text: No account and no name. Quick exit on every screen. Your progress stays on your phone.

download_text: For Android phones. It works offline after the first open, so you only need data once.
download_steps: Tap Download and open the file when it finishes.
If your phone asks, allow installs from this browser.
Open GirlCare72. No account is needed.
partners_text: GirlCare72 is run by Hope Foundation in Imvepi refugee settlement with health centres, boda riders and the GBV case management agency. Partners see anonymous totals only.

faq.a: No. Flashing the number, the call back, the app and the ride to care are free.

faq.q: Will anyone know I used it?
faq.a: Our SMS never say why we call, the app has a neutral name, and quick exit hides it at once.

faq.q: What if I don't have a smartphone?
faq.a: Every feature works by flashing the number or sending SMS.

footer: GirlCare72 is a Hope Foundation programme. Open-source software.
